Unmodified PptxGenJS 4.0.1 browser build and JSZip 3.10.1 browser distribution.
MIT licenses chosen for dual-licensed packages.
See docs/dependencies/pptxgenjs-manifest.json for SHA-512 archive provenance, SHA-256 files and embedded dependencies.
No CDN or Node-only image-size/https packages are used. JSZip browser bundle excludes Node readable-stream implementation.
